- **Handlebar (p04):** clamped at the steerer top, turned 180° so the drops point forward.

- The kit has 11 parts but a complete road bike needs more, so one of seatpost, derailleur or a second handlebar/saddle role is probably unmatched. I left the seatpost and derailleur out.
- The handlebar orientation is the least certain placement.
